visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a black business suit, a white dress shirt, a tie, and glasses, with a prosthetic black mustache, stands in a brightly lit doorway of a modern home. He holds a large dark brown leather briefcase and appears to be speaking to someone off-camera, gesturing with his free hand. The background shows a white door and a glimpse into a living area with a light wood table and some collectibles on a shelf. (2) The scene cuts to the same man now dressed as a student in a white short-sleeved school uniform shirt with blue embroidered text over the pocket and a tan backpack. He looks upwards with a distressed facial expression, his hands clutching the straps of his bag. The setting is a white-walled room with a soft white sofa visible behind him. (3) The man in the suit returns to the doorway, looking at his wristwatch with an impatient expression. He points sternly toward the camera while talking. The lighting is consistent, bright, and flat, highlighting the character's exaggerated features and costume. (4) The character shifts again; the man now wears a messy blonde wig and a light grey shirt, carrying a tan guitar case labeled 'Taylor' as he stands in the doorway waving. He transitions to playing a child character in a grey and navy baseball shirt and a grey cap, looking up with a worried gaze. (5) The man appears in a blue and white plaid shirt with glasses, holding a grey backpack, portraying his 'HowHow' persona. He then cuts to an orange tank top and a yellow bucket hat character holding two toy dinosaurs, a blue shark and a green Godzilla. (6) The 'HowHow' character in the plaid shirt holds a yellow and purple box of 'Fengjie Sheng Yi 712D Probiotics' toward the camera. He demonstrates consuming the product from a white paper sachet, followed by close-up shots of the product packaging on a wooden surface. (7) Finally, the plaid-shirt character and the tank-top character are seen jumping together in a celebratory high-five pose in front of the white sofa, with large text overlays appearing on screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a male voice adopting a deep, stern, and authoritative tone, representing the 'Traditional Asian Parent.' He speaks in Traditional Chinese with high articulation clarity. There is no background music, creating a serious atmosphere focused entirely on the vocal delivery and its dramatic inflection. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect triggers a transition. The vocal quality shifts to a higher pitch and a whiny, youthful timbre to portray the student character 'Xiao Ming.' The speaker's arousal level increases as he expresses distress, with frequent rising intonations indicating questions and complaints to the 'father' figure. (3) Another 'whoosh' SFX signals a shift back to the father's voice, which becomes louder and more impatient, characterized by sharp staccato phrases. The acoustic environment remains clean and dry, resembling a studio recording with minimal ambient noise, emphasizing the rapid-fire dialogue between the two contrasting character voices. (4) A musical transition occurs; an upbeat, high-tempo electronic pop BGM fades in with a steady, driving synthesized beat. The narrator's voice transitions to a neutral, professional narrative tone, explaining the social dynamics of the skit. The music is balanced under the speech, providing an energetic and rhythmic backdrop. (5) As the product pitch for '712D Probiotics' begins, the vocal delivery becomes extremely energetic and bright. Frequent 'ding' and 'bell' sound effects are synchronized with visual text overlays to emphasize product benefits. The BGM remains constant, maintaining high arousal and a positive valence throughout the detailed technical explanation. (6) The video concludes with a mix of enthusiastic shouting and the sound of two voices cheering 'Ya!' and 'Ye!'. The BGM swells slightly in volume before a quick fade-out, ending on a high-energy note that reinforces the comedic and promotional intent of the content.

The intent is to engage the audience through relatable humor before pitching the product as a solution for health and parenting energy.
